clue.text: Family's deserting Artful Dodger — one noted for thieving

indicators.note: the family is leaving, so its letters are taken away from the Dickens character's surname

parts.note: the Artful Dodger in Oliver Twist is Jack Dawkins
kin's: one's family is one's kin

explanation.surface: The pickpocket of Oliver Twist abandons his gang, a known thief.
explanation.walkthrough: The Artful Dodger is the pickpocket in Dickens's Oliver Twist, whose real name is Jack Dawkins; 'deserting' removes KINS from it.
explanation.definitionFit: The bird is famous for stealing shiny objects.

clue.text: Specialised language sometimes used by jewellers

definitions.meaning: technical terminology of a trade or profession
a variant name for jargoon, a pale zircon gemstone

explanation.definitionFit: A word for technical terms; also a variant spelling of a colourless zircon gem.

clue.text: People in official group pledge support for driver

parts.note: to commit oneself is to pledge
a golfer's driver strikes the ball from a tee peg

explanation.surface: Members of a body promise to back a motorist.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'driver' is a golf club, not a motorist.
explanation.definitionFit: A body of members appointed for a specific purpose.

clue.text: The German currency in a rotten state, according to Will

definitions.text: a rotten state, according to Will

parts.note: den is a form of the German definite article
the mark was Germany's money before the euro

explanation.surface: Shakespeare speaks of German money in a corrupt land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' is Shakespeare: Hamlet's 'Something is rotten in the state of...'.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet's kingdom is called rotten by Marcellus.

clue.text: Disconcert right at start of march?

definitions.meaning: soldiers step off on the left, so leading with the right is an error

explanation.definitionFit: To unsettle someone; and the right is the incorrect leg to begin a parade step.

clue.text: For instance, I accumulated wealth

definitions.meaning: the letter I is an example of an upper-case letter
money and assets held, as in a business's funds

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of the fortune they have built up.
explanation.definitionFit: The upper-case I is one such letter; and a stock of money is one's funds.

clue.text: Wrinkly — slow-moving, short of energy

indicators.note: lacking, so a letter is removed

parts.note: creepy can mean creeping, moving slowly
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An old wrinkled creature moving slowly, low on energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Skin that is crinkled like crêpe fabric.

clue.text: Hidden danger if medication is used to cover a foot up

indicators.note: the medicine wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: a pill is a dose of medicine

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A risk arises if a remedy is applied to a raised foot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'if' is a link; 'up' reverses A plus the foot abbreviation, and 'is used to cover' puts the medication round that.
explanation.definitionFit: A concealed trap or unexpected difficulty.

clue.text: Part of record for some athletic events

definitions.meaning: one song or band on an album
running races as opposed to field events

explanation.definitionFit: A single song on an album; and running races, not field events, in athletics.

clue.text: Officials whose decisions are conveyed in outspoken way?

definitions.text: Officials whose decisions are conveyed in outspoken way?

parts.words: Officials whose decisions are conveyed in outspoken way?
parts.note: tennis judges who shout the word 'out', a call that is literally out-spoken

explanation.definitionFit: Judges on the boundary lines call balls out loud.

clue.text: A sermon on conversion — feature of the Vatican?

indicators.note: converting the words changes them into a new form, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A preacher's address about converting the faithful, given in Rome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conversion' shuffles the nine letters of A SERMON ON; the definition plays on Rome as the seat of the Vatican, a facial feature that is 'Roman'.
explanation.definitionFit: A hooked, prominent profile feature, punningly assigned to the Vatican as Rome's own.

clue.text: An author or two

definitions.meaning: Mark ..., the American writer of Huckleberry Finn
an archaic word for a pair

explanation.definitionFit: Mark Twain is a pen name of Samuel Clemens; the same word is an old term for a pair.

clue.text: The other side's message is spelt out at such a board meeting

definitions.text: The other side's message is spelt out at such a board meeting

parts.words: The other side's message is spelt out at such a board meeting
parts.note: a seance where spirits from beyond spell messages letter by letter on a lettered board, not a company directors' meeting

explanation.surface: Minutes of a board meeting spell out the opposition's message.
explanation.definitionFit: A seance board with letters on which the dead supposedly spell out messages.

clue.text: Character remembered as result of way keg with fuse almost exploded

indicators.note: blown apart, so the letters fly into a new order
nearly all of the word fuse, its final letter dropped

explanation.surface: The plotter recalled for packing a keg with a fuse that nearly blew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the E of fuse, leaving FUS; 'exploded' rearranges WAY KEG FUS. The surface is the Gunpowder Plot itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gunpowder Plot conspirator is commemorated each 5 November in Britain with bonfires.

clue.text: Say goodbye and go on holiday

definitions.meaning: to take a period of time off work, as on a vacation

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means bidding farewell, and also using one's allowance of days off work.

clue.text: Englishman about to manoeuvre yacht north? That's brilliant

indicators.note: the Englishman goes around the turned sailing word

parts.note: E for English plus gent for man

indicators.note: in a down answer, going north means reading upwards

parts.note: to luff is to steer a sailing boat closer into the wind

explanation.surface: An Englishman sails his yacht northwards, a splendid sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'north' reverses the sailing verb in this down entry, and 'about' wraps Englishman (E + GENT) round it; 'That's' is a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiant and shining brightly.

clue.text: Craving died, in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: diction is one's style of enunciation
D is the abbreviation of died, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: Someone says a desire died, figuratively speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a manner of speaking' looks like a hedge; it is A + DICTION around D.
explanation.definitionFit: A compulsive dependence or strong need for something.

clue.text: Snake, enraged, produces sound of incipient hiss

parts.note: the asp is a venomous snake
irate means angry

explanation.surface: An angry snake starts to hiss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'incipient hiss' is the first letter H, the breathy sound this verb means.
explanation.definitionFit: To pronounce with an audible breath, the h sound.

clue.text: Unimportant pronouncement from card-player making tricks

indicators.note: a spoken word, so a word that sounds like another is intended

parts.note: slight means unimportant or trivial
of can mean from, as in 'of noble birth'
a hand is a player in a card game such as bridge

explanation.surface: A bridge player makes a trivial remark while taking tricks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pronouncement' signals that SLIGHT is spoken, giving the conjuror's word SLEIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Dexterous conjuring trickery is performed with nimble fingers.

clue.text: Fish intended, we hear, for Jersey or Guernsey, for example

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted fish

indicators.note: spoken out, so the word is heard as one spelt differently

parts.note: meant means intended

explanation.surface: A fish intended for the Channel Islands.
explanation.walkthrough: Jersey and Guernsey are Channel Islands but also knitted woollen jumpers.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are names of woollen sweaters, so items of clothing.

clue.text: When parking, hesitate to cover road

parts.note: as means when, as in 'as I left'
P is the sign for parking
halt means hesitate, waver

explanation.surface: A driver pauses when parking on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: To surface a road with tarmac.

clue.text: Scholar with special technique finishing early in exam

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts

indicators.note: stopping before the end, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a trick is a clever technique, a knack

explanation.surface: A clever student finishes an examination early.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for matriculation, an old school-leaving examination.

clue.text: Just one of the Romans fond of fighting about power

parts.note: Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: the warlike word goes around the letter for power

parts.note: martial means warlike
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: A Roman lover of combat is surprisingly fair-minded.
explanation.definitionFit: A fair, unbiased person is described as such.

clue.text: Soldier turned up without fuel

indicators.note: outside, so the turned word goes around the fuel
turned round, so the word is reversed

parts.note: oil is a fuel

explanation.surface: A soldier is overturned for lack of fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside, not lacking: PU around OIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A French infantryman of the First World War.

clue.text: Run into home with dog

parts.note: in means at home
a cur is a mongrel

explanation.surface: Running into the house with the dog.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring on oneself, as debts or a penalty.

clue.text: Genuine article produced with mischievous spirit

parts.note: Puck is the sprite of A Midsummer Night's Dream
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An authentic item created alongside an impish sprite.
explanation.definitionFit: An Anglo-Indian word meaning real or proper, also spelt pukka.

clue.text: More important part of old record out of consideration

definitions.text: More important part of old record
definitions.meaning: the main track side of a vinyl single, opposite the B-side
put away, set apart from what is being thought about

explanation.definitionFit: The featured side of a 45 single; and something set apart is no longer considered.

clue.text: Entertaining Cockney member of the Foreign Legion?

definitions.meaning: Albert ..., a London music-hall singer of coster songs
a knight of the French Legion of Honour, a legion that is foreign to Britain

explanation.definitionFit: Albert Chevalier was a Victorian music-hall star; a knight of the Légion d'honneur bears the title too.

clue.text: Torque adjusted about a line that's imaginary

indicators.note: the reworked letters go around the a
changed in setting, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mechanic sets the torque on an imaginary line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adjusted' rearranges TORQUE and 'about' puts it around A.
explanation.definitionFit: The great circle around Earth midway between the poles exists only on maps.

clue.text: Movie on a giant scale

definitions.meaning: the 1997 James Cameron film about the doomed liner
huge, colossal, like the Titans of myth

explanation.definitionFit: A blockbuster film about the sunk liner; and huge, as the mythical giants were.
